ideas.title: Investigation into Trump Administration's Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's decision to freeze child care funding and its potential impact on children and families in Minnesota and across the US.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine potential political motivations behind the freeze
questions: What was the decision-making process behind the freeze?
How many child care providers and children are affected?
What are the potential long-term consequences of the freeze?
ideas.insight: This story has significant potential for uncovering potential wrongdoing and highlighting the impact on vulnerable populations. I recommend following the money and examining connections to other Trump administration policies.

ideas.title: Analysis of ICE Shooting in Minneapolis
ideas.description: Examine the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of a woman in Minneapolis by an ICE officer and potential patterns of similar incidents.
ideas.angle: Investigate use of force by ICE officers and community relations
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Are there patterns of similar incidents involving ICE officers?
How can community relations be improved?
ideas.insight: This story has significant potential for uncovering potential wrongdoing and highlighting issues related to community relations and immigration policy. I recommend examining public records and patterns of similar incidents.
